summary: Verified bottom-tab label clipping fix on web preview at both desktop (1440x900) and mobile-web (390x844) viewports. All four tab labels ('Home', 'My Vehicles', 'Submit', 'Profile') now render fully — descenders ('y' in 'My Vehicles', 'p' in 'Profile') are visible with 24px clearance from the viewport bottom. Computed lineHeight=16px, rendered height=16px, minHeight=16px on every label at both viewports. Fix confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/frontend/app/(app)/_layout.tsx is well-scoped: web branch only (Platform.OS === 'web'), native path untouched. Container height 84 with paddingBottom 16 gives 24px of physical clearance below labels; labels themselves have symmetric line-box (16/16) and minHeight guarantees the box never collapses under font-metrics quirks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix for bottom-tab label descender clipping on web is verified good. Container height 84 + paddingBottom 16 + tabBarLabelStyle lineHeight 16 + minHeight 16 produces labels with 24px clearance above the viewport bottom at both 1440x900 and 390x844. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/screenshots/ (desktop_bottom.png and mobile_bottom.png) show 'My Vehicles' and 'Profile' rendered with full descenders. No further changes required.
rca_of_issue: Previous iterations set lineHeight=14 (too tight for 11px font) which caused RN-Web to compute a 9px content box and clip the descenders of 'y' (My Vehicles) and 'p' (Profile) against the tab bar's bottom edge. Iteration 40 bumps to lineHeight=16, adds minHeight=16 as a floor, and bumps container height to 84 with paddingBottom 16 — verified via getBoundingClientRect that each label now has height=16px and 24px of physical clearance from the viewport bottom, eliminating the clip.
